8 احترّ and اجدرّ : see 1, in three places. ＝
-A2- اجترّ said of a camel, (S, Msb, K,) and any other animal having a كَرِش, (S, TA,) [i. e.] any clovenhoofed animal, (Msb,) He ejected the cud from his stomach and ate it again; ruminated; chewed the cud; (S, * Msb, * K * TA;) as also ↓ اجرّ . (Lh, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
